event.openExplain: Choose the .bingoCards file you saved earlier.

event.openStart: Go straight to hosting, with zero calls drawn.

event.nextPrint: Next: review and print your cards
event.openPanelHelp: Select a .bingoCards backup from your device.
event.openHelp: No generating or printing again. Game files contain cards, not past calls.
event.layoutFit: Cards keep a fixed size and are never split across sheets.
event.sameCards: The same cards are used for printing and hosting.
